Keep the focus on O Soberano and the precise visual idea of his fractured authority.

Style/medium: clearly hand-drawn 2D Japanese shonen anime illustration, strong clean ink contours, graphic shapes, flat cel shading and decisive shadow blocks; stylized animation art, not photorealistic and not painterly.
Composition/framing: square 1:1, medium close action view, new angle unlike the portrait, face and raised hand readable, clear foreground/midground separation.

Constraints: preserve the referenced identity and outfit; natural anatomy, five fingers on visible hands; one small distant enemy silhouette only; no gore, no text, no UI, no logo, no watermark.
